---
title: "Join ATLAS"
---

## For students

ATLAS welcomes motivated high school and undergraduate students interested in medicine, public health, data science, or AI. No prior research experience is required. You will need curiosity, commitment, and willingness to learn statistics.

Students in ATLAS will:

* Develop and own a real research question
* Learn graduate-level biostatistics in R and Python
* Complete a review or analysis with a mentor
* Submit abstracts and present at academic conferences
* Use their skills to create real world tools that serve disease prevention, early diagnosis, and increased healthcare utilization

## For partners

We collaborate with public health agencies, community organizations, and researchers who share our commitment to evidence and equity.
